merge_rules: Load broad onboarding preferences, then apply current-session selections.
Never treat onboarding preferences as permissions or exclusions.
Do not overwrite broad account preferences with current-session choices.
Disabled components produce no corresponding audio layers or spoken content.
If narration_enabled=false, ignore all spoken exercise permissions and do not call text-to-speech.
If body_awareness_allowed=false, also disable muscle-tensing exercises.
If imagery_allowed=false, ignore scene preferences for narration. Nature audio can still play if separately enabled.
When every audio component is disabled, explain that no audio is selected and let the user revise their choices; do not generate audio.
Use only compatible techniques from supplied reviewed evidence cards; if none fit, use neutral reassuring narration when narration is enabled.
Choose narrator separately when narration is enabled.
These settings remain editable throughout a session.

storage.merged_input: computed per session, not persisted as replacement preferences
